dialogues.speaker: Amoxcihuatl
dialogues.text: I am Amoxcihuatl, born in the first Year of the Seve{RUBY#[D]Chicome Acatl}n Reeds after the Blazing Sun's return to flame. Once I served as a Recording Officer in the court of the glorious Holy Sov{RUBY#[D]Ti'sakhuun}ereign Kalomte.

dialogues.speaker: Amoxcihuatl
dialogues.text: At the time, I was pursuing a traitor, one who had abandoned the Alliance's oath and forgotten the teachings of the blazing sun. Yet in the end, it was I who became trapped here.

dialogues.speaker: Amoxcihuatl
dialogues.text: My ancestors once shared a cup with the true god. And I — no more than a shadow cast by the blazing sun upon this humble earth — offer you my greeting.
